correctness.rationale: The domain is the finite etale Galois set indexing geometrically irreducible one-dimensional (three-edge) and zero-dimensional (four-edge) boundary strata of the S7 form of Mbar_0,7. Distinct internal edges correspond bijectively to compatible bipartitions of seven labels. The exact checker enumerates all 56 legal splits, checks all compatible 3- and 4-split sets (1260 and 945), and independently reproduces both by leaf insertion and edge contraction. It then uses exact integer permutation cycles for all 15 partitions of seven, computes the complete orbit tables and first five fixed counts, and asserts fifteen unique 1-dimensional signatures, eleven 0-dimensional signatures, precisely four 0-dimensional collision pairs, and the equality of the first four fixed counts for the 7, 5+2, and 5+1+1 partitions but inequality at degree five. Thus finite full enumeration plus the descent lemma proves all q and all finite-etale degree-seven algebras, not only sample fields. Exact certificate: CERTIFICATE.json and verify_boundary7.py. No unproved general n statement is used.

value.rationale: For Galois forms of a fundamental genus-zero moduli compactification, whether arithmetic boundary configuration data determine the splitting of the underlying seven-marking algebra is a natural reconstruction problem. The complete 15-class character for the 1260 natural one-dimensional boundary strata gives a universal criterion, and the four explicit collisions among the 945 deepest-boundary strata exhibit a sharp information transition between natural neighboring strata dimensions. Five initial extension counts are necessary and sufficient; this is not a random finite-field sample, a renaming of a published count, or a routine integral-incidence computation. Its use is exact arithmetic boundary observation, not a claim about full moduli point counts.
